AirGrave.name: Airgrave
AirGrave.summary: Airgrave is a vertical scrolling shoot-em-up where you pilot one of four fighter ships against the MUCOC forces across eight stages. Each character has unique stats and story sequences with voiced cutscenes. Lock onto multiple enemies simultaneously for bonus points, and build an Overdrive meter to unleash powerful attacks. Multiple endings encourage replaying with different pilots.

Click Manga - Dynamic Robot Taisen 2 - K.name: Click Manga: Dynamic Robot Taisen 2 - Kyoufu! Akuma Zoku Fukkatsu
Click Manga - Dynamic Robot Taisen 2 - K.summary: Click Manga: Dynamic Robot Taisen 2: Kyoufu! Akuma Zoku Fukkatsu is an interactive manga for PlayStation based on the major characters created by Go Nagai and Dynamic Productions. It was published by Tokuma Publishing Co. on December 16, 1999.

Clock Tower - The First Fear.name: Clock Tower: The First Fear
Clock Tower - The First Fear.summary: The story follows orphan Jennifer Simpson soon after she is adopted by the Barrows family along with other orphaned girls. With the introduction of Scissorman, the game's antagonist, one of the other children is killed. Jennifer must then explore the Barrows Mansion to find a way to escape while evading Scissorman.

Dukes of Hazzard, The - Racing for Home.name: The Dukes of Hazzard: Racing for Home
Dukes of Hazzard, The - Racing for Home.summary:
The Dukes are back!

Climb behind the wheel of the General Lee and tear through the hiills of Hazzard in the craziest, smash 'em up, drive like-a-maniac racing game you've ever played. It's a dream come true as you undertake the twenty-seven fast-paced, arcade-style missions that await you.

EPS Series Vol. 3 - Come and Kiss Me - T.name: EPS Series Vol. 3: Come and Kiss Me - Tomomi Tsunoda
EPS Series Vol. 3 - Come and Kiss Me - T.summary: Idle Satomi Tsunoda music and huge photos, music software to enjoy in the PS that the video clip was recorded. In addition to the original song two songs and remix one song, photo collection that spans more than 220 points, recorded a promotional video clips with an original editing function taking advantage of the live-action capture technology with the PS, to realize the beauty of the still images and video you have.

Formation Soccer '98 - Ganbare Nippon in.name: Formation Soccer '98 - Ganbare Nippon in France
Formation Soccer '98 - Ganbare Nippon in.summary: After the releases of the SNES & N64 games, Formation Soccer '98 - Ganbare Nippon in France is the third game for Playstation One, the game features the national teams that had entered the World Cup '98, and a new different camera angle.

Glover.name: Glover
Glover.summary: This is the PlayStation port of Glover, a platforming video game featuring a magical, four-fingered glove named Glover in his quest to restore the Crystal Kingdom by retrieving crystals that were lost.

Groove Adventure Rave - Yuukyuu no Kizun.name: Groove Adventure Rave
Groove Adventure Rave - Yuukyuu no Kizun.summary:
Released only in Japan, Groove Adventure Rave is the first action RPG game based on the Rave Master manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima.

This action RPG includes a original story with a new character created by the original author Mashima-sensei, featuring the RPD system where your companions trust changes based on the aciton you make.

International Track & Field 2000.name: International Track & Field 2000
International Track & Field 2000.summary: Pure adrenaline! Go for gold with the only Track and Field title for Nintendo 64! Lightning-fast gameplay for up to four players. Over a dozen grueling international events, from weightlifting, to gymnastics, to the 100M dash.

NCAA March Madness 2000.name: NCAA March Madness 2000
NCAA March Madness 2000.summary: NCAA March Madness 2000 was the 1999 installment in the NCAA March Madness series. It was released on November 30, 1999 for the PlayStation. Former Maryland player Steve Francis is featured on the cover.

Soumatou.name: Deception III: Dark Delusion
Soumatou.summary:
Taken against her will to Alendar Kingdom, Layna who becomes your challenge is now under the control of the evil King Frederick. As her life wears thin, it becomes your sole mission to ensure Layna saves herself as King Frederick's mysterious organization attempts to bring Layna to her final doom. Through preparation of strategic trap setting you begin to plot and devise various techniques to destroy those who hold you captive. With over 2,000 trap variations it is up to you to choose the best combinations to assist you in conquering your enemy. Because there are multiple endings. Layna's final fate may be your worst nightmare or ultimate fantasy. The choice is yours. The options are endless.

* Over 2,000 trap variations
* New and improved trap element system allows more freedom for players to develop traps.
* Advanced 3D Polygon Graphics with Third Person Perspective.
* Four modes of play are offered including the "Scenario Mode", "Trap License Mode", "Free Training Mode", and the "Expert Mode".
* Multiple endings!

Tyco R-C - Assault with a Battery.name: Tyco R/C: Assault with a Battery
Tyco R-C - Assault with a Battery.summary: Taking RC racing to the next level, TYCO RC: Assault With a Battery is every schoolyard remote-controlled racer's dream come true. Choose one of eight RC cars modeled after real life Tyco-brand toy racers such as The Recoil, Fast Traxx and Hot Rocker. Each racer is completely unique and brandishes it's own signature maneuver breaking out with awesome offensive or defensive moves, or even morphing into a menacing super car. Race as Tantrum, replete with a front-spinning axle that damages all in it's path; Nitro-Dozer, with the ability to transform into a powerful bulldozer; or even Speed Wrench, a monster truck that becomes an on-road terror twice it's width. The elaborate detail in the construction of the vehicles is also found in such features as each individual racer's speed, acceleration rate, turning ratio, and all-out power. Test your skills in Single-Player mode or challenge your friends in Two-Player. With theme-based courses designed for maximum mayhem, TYCO RC: Assault With a Battery delivers all the excitement without having to tell Mom you destroyed another car.

Wild Arms.name: Wild Arms
Wild Arms.summary: Wild Arms is a Western-themed role-playing video game developed by Japanese software company Media.Vision. Originally released in Japan in 1996 for the Sony PlayStation video game console, it was later translated and released in North America in 1997 and Europe in 1998 by Sony Computer Entertainment. It is noteworthy for not only being one of the first role-playing video games on the PlayStation, but also one of the few to feature a Western American setting and motif. The game features 2D computer graphics for normal gameplay, while battle sequences are rendered in 3D.
